species.real: That scream in the night that sounds like someone being murdered is usually a vixen calling in the winter mating season. Nobody is being murdered; it just feels personal.
species.name: Binfox

dex.text: Has read every bin on the estate and is halfway through the recycling. Shows no remorse, only a fine sense of timing and a good eye for chips.
dex.fact: Foxes have vertical, slit-shaped pupils, like cats, which help them see well in dim light.

species.real: A fox pouncing on prey under snow may use the Earth's magnetic field as a range-finder: one study found they strike most often when jumping towards the north-east.
species.name: Brushmaster

dex.text: Has stopped raiding the bins and started running the estate. Immaculate brush, impeccable timing, and a look that says the recycling was like that when it arrived.
dex.fact: A fox's tail is called a brush, and it works as a rudder when the fox runs and as a scarf when it sleeps.
